description: This Java class provides a base implementation for an application that consumes telemetry and event data from devices connected to the Eclipse Hono platform and sends commands to those devices via Hono's messaging client. It manages connections, message handling, and command lifecycle, including handling device notifications, scheduling periodic commands, and supporting both telemetry and event message processing.

classes.name: HonoExampleApplicationBase
classes.description: A base class that handles connecting to Hono, consuming telemetry and event messages, and managing device commands, including processing device readiness notifications and periodic command scheduling.

methods.name: HonoExampleApplicationBase
methods.description: Constructor setting up the client factory with host and security properties.

methods.name: consumeData
methods.description: Establishes connection to Hono, creates message consumers, and waits for user input to terminate.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates and initializes message consumers for telemetry and event messages, setting up handlers for message processing.

methods.name: handleCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications indicating device readiness for commands, delegating to specific handlers based on TTD value.

methods.name: handlePermanentlyConnectedCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Manages notifications for devices that remain connected, scheduling periodic commands or immediate commands based on TTD.

methods.name: createCommandClientAndSendCommand
methods.description: Gets or creates a command client for a device and sends a command based on a notification.

methods.name: calculateCommandTimeout
methods.description: Calculates the timeout for commands based on TTD and expiry time.

methods.name: setPeriodicCommandSenderTimerCanceler
methods.description: Registers a canceler handle to stop periodic command sending and close the command client.

methods.name: cancelPeriodicCommandSender
methods.description: Cancels an active periodic command sender for a device.

methods.name: isPeriodicCommandSenderActiveForDevice
methods.description: Checks if periodic command sender is active for the device.

methods.name: sendCommandToAdapter
methods.description: Sends a command to a device via the command client, handling success and errors, and closing the client if necessary.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommandToAdapter
methods.description: Sends a one-way command to a device, with similar handling as sendCommandToAdapter.

methods.name: closeCommandClient
methods.description: Closes the command client and logs the action.

methods.name: buildCommandProperties
methods.description: Creates application properties to include in commands.

methods.name: buildCommandPayload
methods.description: Builds a JSON payload for commands, e.g., setting brightness.

methods.name: buildOneWayCommandPayload
methods.description: Builds a JSON payload for one-way commands, e.g., restarting the app.
